articleTitle: Pattern Recognition for Uterine Fibroid Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Pattern recognition plays a significant role in the detection of uterine fibroids through various medical imaging modalities such as ultrasound, Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI), and computed tomography (CT) scans. Ultrasound imaging helps identify hypoechoic masses within the uterine muscle layer, while MRI provides detailed images showing well-defined masses with characteristic signal intensities on Tl-weighted and T2-weighted sequences. CT imaging, though less common, is used to detect fibroids based on hypodense masses within the uterus or pelvic cavity. Computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) systems and advanced machine-learning algorithms aid in automating the detection and characterization of fibroids by analyzing image features such as shape, texture, and intensity. These pattern recognition techniques facilitate early diagnosis and accurate assessment of uterine fibroids, enabling timely management and treatment of this prevalent gynecological condition.

articleTitle: Detection of Low-Frequency Vibration Using Fiber Bragg Grating Interrogation System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Vibration modes analysis is commonly used to detect the defects of mechanical devices, especially for the low-frequency vibration mode spectrum. The low-frequency mode is hard to detect by electro-mechanical detectors due to its limited sensitivity to low-frequency vibration. Thus, we developed a method using the Fiber Bragg grating sensor to detect the low-frequency vibration related to the operation of a motorcycle engine.

articleTitle: Anxiety and Depression Related Characteristics of Parents of Exceptional Children Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: In this study., advanced machine learning algorithms were used in conjunction with the SCL-90 scale to conduct an indepth cluster analysis of the mental health status of parents of exceptional children. By collecting and analyzing the mental health data of these parents and using machine learning techniques., different patterns of psychological characteristics of anxiety and depression were identified. The findings revealed a complex relationship between anxiety and depression levels and multiple factors such as family support., social support., and individual coping strategies. The clustering analysis of the machine learning model enabled the identification of different psychological trait groups with specific anxiety and depression manifestations., providing a scientific basis for further psychological intervention and support.

articleTitle: Analysis of Performance of a Stationary LiDAR Sensor in Dynamic Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: The technologies developed during the COVID-19 pandemic present numerous opportunities for innovation. With the World Health Organization no longer classifying COVID-19 as a global public health emergency, the heightened state of alert is receding. The new technologies that emerged during this period lay the groundwork for fresh opportunities and applications. This study examines the base station of a Social Distancing Reminder (SDR) LiDAR device introduced to the market during COVID-19-an “exaptation” incorporating charging, stationary features, and anchor functionality. While the sensor performs well in practical simulations, the reports from the consumers sometimes express dissatisfaction about the consistency of sensor performance. The mixed response calls for a deeper study of sensor operational parametersi. Furthermore, w hen configured as a stationary product, this straightforward device opens up possibilities for integration in public spaces, schools, workplaces, and recreational areas. Emphasizing its stationary nature positions this technology as a foundation for broader applications beyond COVID-19, such as crowd management, space utilization, and enhancing safety protocols in emergencies. The station underwent testing for consistency under five real-world variables across four SDR devices. This device provides a real-time solution for managing workspace occupancy when placed on a surface. The results demonstrate constraints for the utility of the device under varying lighting and device heights. The sensor's vision cone was found to be 13 degrees, requiring a minimum lighting level of 40 lux - a characteristic that must be conveyed to the users, who otherwise tend to complain about the functionality of the device.

articleTitle: Integrating Artistic Screen Dots for Anti-Counterfeiting in High-Capacity Graphic QR Code for Medical Care
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: The Quick Response code (QR code) is a medium linking the virtual and real worlds and is widely used in daily life including the healthcare sector. However, current QR codes have limited information storage capacity and are visually unappealing. With the rapid advancement of technology, distinguishing between genuine and counterfeit items has become increasingly challenging, especially since the commonly used QR codes lack an anti-counterfeiting mechanism to protect privacy and ensure information security. Thus, we designed a graphic QR code with high capacity, high visual quality, and multiple anti-counterfeiting features while still being machine-readable. We randomly scrambled the eight private QR codes, excluding the public data, using a pseudo-random method by inputting the key. We embedded and blended them with the public data QR code while incorporating artistic screen dots. The hidden information is revealed and verified when overlaid with a decoding mask. The Nine distinct QR codes were successfully restored and read. QR codes are used to deliver public information with a programmatic algorithm to decode hidden messages. By adjusting the tone parameter, the readability was improved. The developed QR code can be applied in the healthcare industry to enhance security and advance the quality of medical services.

articleTitle: Design Mechanism of Intelligent Financial Analysis System Based on Data Mining Technology and Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: The proposed intelligent financial analysis system leverages data mining techniques, integrating AI and audit expertise. It includes a novel short-text classification algorithm based on a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) neural network. This algorithm addresses feature sparsity, high dimensionality, and inadequate semantic feature extraction typical of short text data. By combining Word2vec, TF-IDF, and LDA topic modeling, the system creates a vector that captures semantic, importance, and topic features. The BiLSTM architecture processes texts in forward and backward directions, enhancing context understanding and mitigating gradient issues associated with traditional Recurrent neural networks. The algorithm is designed for text preprocessing, vector representation, neural network construction, and classification and evaluation. This approach ensures accurate and efficient financial audit text classification, providing valuable insights and recommendations.

articleTitle: Gender Equality Algorithms in Chinese Cities in Big Data Era
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: With the development of big data technology, algorithms play increasingly important roles in social governance and decision-making. However, the problem of gender bias poses a threat to social equality during the design and application of algorithms. Thus, it is necessary to explore the importance and challenges of gender equality algorithms in the era of big data and develop gender equality algorithms in Chinese cities. Possible gender biases in current algorithms were analyzed to propose methods to identify and correct these biases. The results of the study showed that the gender sensitivity of algorithms can be effectively enhanced through multidisciplinary cross-cooperation and technological innovation to promote gender equality.

articleTitle: Integration of Multiple Sensor-Based Wellness Systems for Supportive Housing Using Bluetooth Low Energy
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Residents in permanent supportive housing, defined as long-term, community-based housing combined with supportive services, often have health conditions requiring daily medication and monitoring for disabling incidents inside their home. Sensor-based solutions for checking for immobile residents, and automatic pill dispensers to ensure the timely delivery of medications are being developed to support living with health conditions. This work describes how multiple such health monitoring devices can be coordinated from a single user interface with communication over Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE). Individual subsystems, including an automatic pill dispenser and a smart wellness check, are designed for use within a supportive housing apartment unit. An Arduino RP2040 micro controller is used as each subsystem's central processing unit. The foundation of the communication between the different subsystems is the BLE protocol. BLE was chosen for its adaptability to heterogeneous devices and low power consumption. The BLE communication architecture links these devices, facilitating reliable data transfer and device-to-device coordination. An Android application running on a tablet PC acts as the central coordinator of all subsystems and provides a unified user interface. The application scans for BLE devices, connects to discovered subsystems, and displays real-time sensor information in a user-friendly format. Nearby peripheral devices are identified using BLE advertising and scanning. Bidirectional communication channels are created once linked, enabling the central device to communicate with the peripherals and receive data from them. This BLE architecture supports simultaneous communication with multiple peripherals. Different parameters of the BLE protocol are systematically varied; the parameters are the MTU size, time interval for BLE device scans, and the resulting number of GATT connections and disconnections under various time intervals. Fine tuning these parameters enables the identification of the optimal set of parameter values for reliable data transfer between the central user interface and individual subsystems with minimum latency and maximum energy conservation.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Analysis System for Academic Conditions in Vocational Colleges Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: We designed and implemented an intelligent analysis system for academic conditions in vocational colleges using data mining techniques. By constructing three classification models-Decision Tree, Backpropagation Neural Network, and Convolutional Neural Network-we evaluated and predicted student performance based on indicators such as perceptions of the educational environment, challenges faced, motivation levels, and invested effort. The collected data was preprocessed to address class imbalance, which significantly impacts model accuracy. Different models and sampling methods affected the predictive performance of models. The model provides information to enhance educational practices and resource allocation. Data mining in educational analysis significantly improves the understanding of academic conditions and support mechanisms for improvements and student success in vocational colleges.

articleTitle: Compact 90° Coplanar Waveguide Bend Using Open-Circuited Stubs
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: We have developed a compact 90° coplanar waveguide (CPW) bend utilizing the open-circuited (OC) stubs. The 90° CPW bend utilizing the OC stubs has a compact size of 8.4 mm. The 90° CPW bend utilizing the OC stubs can substantially decrease the reflection coefficient of the 90° CPW bend from -2.44 to -14.25 dB and increase the transmission coefficient of the 90° CPW bend from -16.07 to -1.63 dB as compared with the reflection and transmission coefficients of the un-compensated 90° CPW bend. Furthermore, it enhances the signal integrity of the 90° CPW bend and reduces the power loss of the 90° CPW bend from 60 to 28% as compared with the power loss of the un-compensated 90° CPW bend.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on Effect of Mathematical Visualization Tools on Learning Partial Differential Equations Using Java 2 Platform Enterprise Edition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: This study aims to assess the pedagogical effectiveness of mathematical visualization tools, particularly GeoGebra software, in promoting students' conceptual understanding and mastery of partial differential equations (PDEs). An online teaching platform with J2EE architecture was used to integrate the dynamic visualization features of GeoGebra to enrich students' interactive learning experience. By implementing pre-and post-tests and comparing the academic performance of students in the experimental and control groups, the impact of the math visualization tool on learning outcomes was analyzed. The students in the experimental group understood abstract concepts through the spatial visualization of PDEs. In addition, student feedback revealed that the mathematical visualization tool enhanced their interest and intrinsic motivation in learning and stimulated their desire to explore mathematical concepts in depth. The findings of this study can be a basis for mathematics education practices, confirming that the integration of mathematics visualization tools, such as GeoGebra, into an instructional platform based on the J2EE architecture, significantly improves student learning outcomes. This finding has important implications for educators to incorporate modern technologies in instructional designs to promote better understanding and application of complex mathematical concepts of students.

articleTitle: Meal Image Recognition and Healthy Meal Combination Recommendation System Integrated with Generative Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: People increasingly prioritize a balanced diet to enhance well-being, yet making informed dietary choices remains challenging amidst the abundance of options. To address this, we developed a meal image recognition and healthy meal combination recommender system, integrating generative artificial intelligence (AI). Convolutional neural networks were used for precise meal image recognition to identify diverse food items. The generative AI-augmented recommendation engine offers personalized meal suggestions aligned with nutritional goals and dietary preferences, utilizing a nutrition knowledge base to ensure overall well-being. The system's feasibility was validated, illustrating its excellence in meal recognition accuracy, recommendation diversity, and user engagement. By integrating generative AI, the system shows its potential to enhance dietary recommendations and public health.

articleTitle: Aberrant Behavior Detection Using Three-Dimensional Stereo Video
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Surveillance technology has become fundamental to the security of living spaces. Police agencies, manufacturers, and individuals have deployed many video monitoring equipment in various environments. In this study, we used stereoscopic image technology for malicious behavior detection. The system framework proposed in this study consists of active capture, visual focus retrieval, and event detection. We used a depth sensor for three-dimensional stereo video. We developed a method by using the three-dimensional stereo video to detect the behavior in the aberrant event. We experimented with collected datasets in this study, and an accuracy of 95.8% and an F1 Score of 79% were obtained in predicting aberrant behavior detection.

articleTitle: An fNIRS and EEG-Based Deep Learning Model for Consumer Taste Classification using BCI and Neuromarketing for Health Promotion
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: In creating nutritional products, consideration of taste can be crucial, and a method for measuring and classifying the taste preferences of individuals can provide information for producers to adapt to consumer taste profiles. Through Brain-Computer Interfacing (BCI) the ranking of a consumer's taste preference can be measured and analyzed. Taste is a significant characteristic in food choice, and this study explores a novel method of understanding taste preference using multiple BCI signals and a Linear Regression Kernel classification model. Using a wet g. Nautilus fNIRS-8 Research Headset, Electroencephalography (EEG) and Functional Near-Infrared Spectroscopy data are recorded from participants when tasting samples. Recorded data are processed and provided to a machine-learning model for classification. The Linear Regression Kernel model trained can only classify taste preferences with an accuracy of 35.9%. The data this study has collected includes 39 recorded tasting trials in sets of three from 10 subjects tasting 3 different brands of coffee.

articleTitle: Models for Enhancing Competitiveness of Rural Societies in Intelligent Era: Design of APP for Independent Elderly Care Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: In this study, a rural autonomous elderly care APP was developed based on the Delphi questionnaire. A self-dependent elderly care model was applied to the rural elderly to improve efficiency and accuracy. We conducted a literature review with expert interviews with 25 experts in two rounds of questionnaire surveys. Factor analysis was applied to analyze the data. 11 indicators of demand adaptability, 6 indicators of system ease of use, 7 indicators of system inclusiveness, and 8 indicators of emotional support were determined in 4 dimensions. The alpha values of the 32 indicators were greater than 0.7, and the factor loadings ranged from 0.7 to 0.94. the functions constructed in this study belonged to the three levels of science, system, and theory. The results provide a reference for the practice of APP design for the rural elderly to meet the demand for the specificity and universality of APPs.

articleTitle: Analyzing Load-Bearing Capacity Of Spinal Orthosis Brace in Treatment of Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis with 3D Printed Plastic Materials
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: A spinal Orthosis Brace is an effective nonsurgical treatment for patients with Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis (AIS). Four factors affect the treatment results of braces: (1) the risk of curve growth, (2) in-brace correction, (3) brace quality, and (4) brace wear quantity. Flexibility of the spine directly affects inbrace correction. The quality of brace design also affects in-brace correction and comfort and brace wear quantity. Traditional braces are bulky and uncomfortable, the production process takes a lot of time and effort, and there are no standards for comparison. We designed a treatment brace for children with AIS using 3D-printed materials. We conducted FEM structural analysis to evaluate the initial correction ability of the brace. In designing braces, FEM was used to visualize structures in detail and show the distribution of stress and displacement, which saved time and costs. The new design also reduced weight and materials, and increased product durability. In addition, the application of 3D printing technology allowed for a comfortable, light, and personalized product. In particular, the patient's satisfaction with the splint shirt and self-consciousness when wearing it, so the patient's compliance (wearing the brace for the prescribed number of hours) was improved for treatment.

articleTitle: Development and Implementation of an Interactive App to Manage Symptoms of Postural Orthostatic Tachycardia Syndrome Using Real-Time Heart Rate Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Postural Orthostatic Tachycardia Syndrome (POTS) is a type of autonomic dysfunction affecting blood circulation, marked by excessive tachycardia and orthostatic intolerance. One primary non-pharmacological management approach for POTS is pacing. Pacing involves organizing daily activities to minimize severe symptom fluctuations. Heart rate monitoring is crucial for helping POTS patients manage symptoms and implement effective pacing strategies. Optimizing daily pacing strategies using heart rate data involves understanding personal heart rate zones, tracking heart rate during different activities, and analyzing this data to adjust individual pacing strategies for improved performance and endurance. This paper details developing and implementing an interactive app to support real-time pacing strategies for POTS patients. The system is designed to identify triggers that exacerbate POTS symptoms, monitor heart rate, and provide real-time clinical suggestions for managing POTS. The app generates personalized alerts to mitigate heart rate and minimize symptom escalation by utilizing a wearable device for real-time data communication via the cloud to a decision support server using IoT architecture. The Apple Watch Series 9 was chosen to meet these requirements. The system enables the clinical team to create individualized POTS management programs, including situational suggestions, heart rate analysis parameters, and personalized alerts. A dedicated clinician website was developed to manage and communicate with patient smartwatch devices and prescribe individualized POTS self-management plans. The clinician portal supports setting up three types of alerts (situational suggestions, status checks, and email/text messaging to patients, providers, and caregivers) and reviewing collected data to adjust patients' self-management plans based on performance. Initial usability inspections through cognitive walkthroughs and heuristic evaluations indicate that the interactive POTS management app provides valuable data for adjusting activity levels, preventing overexertion, and optimizing pacing techniques for POTS patients.

articleTitle: Decision Model of Types of Cultural and Creative Industry Based on Delphi Analytic Hierarchy Process: A Case Study for Sanjiang Liuan Area of Dongguan, China
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: U sing the Delphi Analytic Hierarchy Process, we explored from value reconstruction and spatial transformation of postmodern culture. We constructed a decision model for ontological interpretation based on the cultural variables to determine the types and characteristics of the cultural and creative industry in the Sanjiang Liuan area of Dongguan in China. In the model, we carried out a qualitative and quantitative analysis to understand the present status and future development direction of the industry in the area. The results provide a basis for further research and judgment on the development and positioning of the cultural and creative industry in towns and streets of the study area.

articleTitle: Modeling of PEDOT:PSS Electrodes for Skin-Based Technologies as Discrete Electrical Components
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Polymers have been a chosen material for electrodes in various electrical medical applications. To safely and efficiently record high-frequency electrical signals, electrodes made of polymers with large surface areas and high conductivity are necessary for minimal change in impedance. A common strategy followed is the modification of electrodes with materials that stabilize the resistance, under repetitive stretch-release cycles. Here, PEDOT:PSS-coated (PEDOT:PSS) electrodes are examined for recording high frequency electric signals and compared to plain metal electrodes, connecting it to a skin model. Theoretical modeling of plain metal and PEDOT:PSS electrodes, through circuit simulation demonstrates PEDOT:PSS with its polymer blending is well suited material for high frequency electric signals on skin-based technologies, than plain metal electrodes. This is because PEDOT:PSS due to the presence of a volumetric capacitor results in high electrical conductivity (~1700 S/cm), and minimal change in resistance (~4%) under repetitive stretch-release cycles at 40% tensile strain after stabilization. These properties allow PEDOT:PSS to be a very effective material for recording of biomedical signals.

articleTitle: Threat to Rogue Base Station in Home Healthcare Ecosystem
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: With increasing aging populations and their chronic illnesses, the importance of the home healthcare ecosystem is growing to reduce the need for hospital visits by providing medical care at home. The integration of 5G technology holds potential in the home healthcare ecosystem as 5G offers low latency, high throughput, and massive machine-type communication, supporting various medical devices and sensors, fundamentally transforming patient care. It also allows for remote real-time monitoring of vital signs, facilitating access to healthcare services. However, concerns about information security become serious, particularly regarding the cybersecurity of 5G base stations in the ecosystem. Unauthorized access or tampering with these base stations disrupts medical devices, leads to data breaches, or even deploys rogue base stations for malicious purposes such as stealing user information. Therefore, we investigated the threat of rogue base stations and found an effective way to secure the home healthcare ecosystem.

articleTitle: Automatic Violence Detection Technique Using Mobinet
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Deep learning holds great significance in machine learning since it effectively addresses a wide range of problems. The ability to identify violence from various video surveillance systems is one such crucial real-world application. Many crimes are occurring in numerous public spaces as a result of inadequate security. Many methods have been proposed to solve this specific problem, however they have drawbacks. Additionally, they are ineffective since they are dependent on certain conditions. Therefore, we presented an efficient automatic violence detection method for video datasets. We created a video dataset consisting of 1000 videos, half of which featured violent content and the other half did non-violent content. We used a Deep Neural Network technique called MobilNet for detecting violence from videos. Additionally, we employed a variety of deep learning and machine learning strategies to increase the precision. With the training data, the classification model showed an accuracy of 97.50% while with the test data, the accuracy was 95.60%. Performance evaluation results demonstrated that the suggested method identified violent content in videos successfully. The method for video violence detection performed better than many other methods already in use.

articleTitle: Analyzing Load-Bearing Capacity of Ankle Foot Orthosis Using Mesh Structure for Post-Stroke Functional Rehabilitation Treatment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Ankle Foot Orthosis is a crucial device in the functional rehabilitation of patients with foot dysfunction. Currently, the application of the Personalized Medicine (PM) model is used to create customized ankle foot orthoses and meet the individual needs of each patient. 3D printing technology is essential in transitioning from the idea to the application of the PM model. Ankle foot orthosis improves and partially overcomes the limitations of traditional casting methods. The initial design of the ankle foot orthosis is appropriate for various age groups, but it still carries a bulky appearance due to its solid structure. This reduces the attractiveness and comfort of the product for users. Therefore, using nTopology software for Topology optimization and designing a mesh structure, an ankle foot orthosis was developed to meet requirements and durability and provide breathability, comfort, lightness, and aesthetics for patients. The design and the load-bearing capability of the ankle foot orthosis were validated using Ansys Workbench software.

articleTitle: Security and Privacy Threats of O-RAN for Home Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: In recent years, the rapid expansion of home healthcare has increased the demand for efficient medical services and the optimal utilization of medical resources. Thus, Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) technology is used for such an innovation. As a revolutionary wireless communication architecture, O-RAN technology offers advantages, including openness, flexibility, and scalability, rendering it an ideal solution for home healthcare applications. However, the utilization of O-RAN and 5G base stations in home healthcare systems also presents information security concerns. One significant risk entails the potential for unauthorized base stations to intercept or manipulate data, posing a threat to the integrity and confidentiality of home healthcare information. Moreover, there exists the risk of individuals attempting to intercept messages to access sensitive medical data, thereby compromising patient privacy. Given these challenges, it is imperative to identify and address potential security vulnerabilities inherent in O-RAN technology, thereby ensuring the robust security of home healthcare systems.

articleTitle: Employing Near-Field Communication Technology to Construct Memory Vaults for Dementia Patients
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: We solved the problems in operating electronic devices that elderly dementia patients encounter every day. Using Near Field Communication (NFC) technology that enables data exchange simply by smartphone detection, we addressed the inconvenience encountered by dementia patients for long-term care. We collected data on the needs of the patients through questionnaire surveys to understand the functionalities they prioritize while operating electronic devices. Subsequently, based on these requirements, we developed a method to improve their convenience. The designed device was then provided to the patients to collect their feedback and insights on the product usage. Finally, the structure of the product was optimized by solving the identified issues to make it more practical and user-friendly. The proposed design of “Establishing Memory, Treasures Operating NFC” provides the following functions: (1) Integration of commonly used electronic information functions for users into a tagbook for instant access and (2) After users exchange data by sensing the tag with their smartphones, they immediately access the electronic information target page in a single step. The method enhances the convenience of dementia patients in operating electronic products, improves the immediacy of dementia patients in accessing electronic information, and provides convenient tools for long-term caregivers. The product helps dementia patients live more conveniently.

articleTitle: Remote Monitoring and Detection of Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Disease Through Wireless EMG Measurement System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) is one of the most common neuro-muscular diseases and it affects both lower and upper motor neurons in human beings. ALS requires periodic monitoring of the patient, and an early diagnosis helps prevent the disorder from progressing further, thereby improving the quality of life for patients. In this study, we demonstrated a proof-of-concept, point-of-care diagnostics system to measure the surface-EMG signal of a patient. It automatically detects whether the patient is subjected to ALS condition or not by appropriately analyzing the EMG signal. The proposed system consists of required electronics hardware in terms of sensors, front-end signal-processing circuits, and wireless modules to transmit the measured EMG signals onto a remote server through the Internet. The proposed system consists of necessary software modules, machine-learning models, and signal-processing algorithms to detect and classify whether the measured EMG signal from a patient corresponds to the given pathological condition (ALS) or not. The developed framework contains a modified VGG-5 Network, called SpinaINet-VGG, and classifies the Spectrogram of EMG signals to identify the ALS condition. The variations in the spectrogram of the EMG signals form the basis of the proposed framework. The proposed methodology for ALS disease detection involves two major segments: the generation of 2D spectrograms from Raw EMG Signals and the classification of spectrograms using SpinalN et. The performance was evaluated using popular metrics such as overall accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity and was compared with existing methods. The proposed method showed an accuracy of 96.08 %. The proposed system can be used as a point-of-care diagnostic device to help patients monitor by themselves and transmit EMG signals over the Internet to a remote server so that a physician can use the measured data for remote diagnosis.

articleTitle: Diagnosis System Using Tongue Coating Color Based on Improved YOLOv5s
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: In traditional Chinese medicine (TCM), tongue diagnosis requires doctors' subjective judgments, based on their experience and knowledge. With the development of artificial intelligence (AI) technology, deep learning models are available with TCM. In this study, tongue image data were annotated based on the theory of TCM, and 1400 tongue pictures were labeled. By using an improved YOLOv5s model for classification, the model accurately distinguished five tongue features: mirror tongue, thin white fur tongue, white greasy fur tongue, yellow greasy fur tongue, and gray-black fur tongue. Comparing tongue manifestations and body constitutions in TCM, health status was provided. The front-end interface was developed to display results on a WEB page. The developed tongue diagnosis system improves the objectivity, accuracy, and efficiency of tongue diagnosis, and allows for more possibilities for TCM diagnosis and treatment.

articleTitle: AI-Enhanced Assistive Tools with Hand Skeleton Analysis in Online Arts Education
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: The global COVID-19 pandemic has significantly impacted education worldwide, leading to a transition from traditional in-person teaching to asynchronous online learning. Thanks to the valuable contributions of numerous high-quality educational content creators, online audiovisual materials have opened up boundless opportunities for cross-border, crossdisciplinary online learning. This removes geographical and temporal barriers and broadens the spectrum of learning resources available to individuals with diverse needs. Particularly for individuals with disabilities, mobility impairments, or social anxiety, online learning offers an inclusive and accessible environment, fostering the democratization and equity of education and ensuring highquality education regardless of physical conditions or locations. However, unlike foundational subjects, the learning process for arts heavily relies on live demonstrations by teachers and imitation by students, presenting a challenge in the online learning setting especially true for beginners as learning arts often necessitates personalized guidance and real-time feedback. To address this challenge, Mediapipe technology was used to capture the hand movements of both teachers and students in this study. Aeep learning model was used to analyze the similarity of pen-holding postures between students and teachers, thereby providing real-time feedback to supplement the lack of interactivity in online drawing learning and enhance learning outcomes. The developed learning method simulates the role of teachers in traditional classrooms and widens the scope of arts education, providing AI-powered tools for those interested in cultivating aesthetics and lifelong learning opportunities. For the care of the elderly, in addition to enhancing emotional and psychological well-being through aesthetics, the method can be utilized for rehabilitation or the assessment of degenerative conditions.

articleTitle: Integrating IoT in Electrical Charging Roads
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: As the demand for electric vehicles continues to rise, so do the infrastructure requirements needed to make it a viable alternative to internal combustion engine vehicles. While the sales of EVs have been steadily increasing over the years, there is still an inadequate amount of charging stations available for the owners to power their EVs with. New European car sales alone are projected to be 75% electric by 2030, according to the management consultancy McKinsey. The research firm Berg Insight predicts that there will be roughly 23 million EV charging stations around the world by 2025, but there will only be about eight million units in North America and Europe. The proposal is to embed wireless charging in roads, which will involve exchanging data between the EV and charging stations, traffic lights, and roadside units as well as between an ESP32. The built-in Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and CAN bus can be utilized to enable communication between a charging station and an EV, which could then be used to set up charging parameters, automated billing authentication, EV-to-EV communication, as well as share traffic data. The ESP32 is also capable of interacting with physical/capacitive buttons as well as touchscreens, which would allow the user to interact with the charging station. The data for this would be sent to cloud servers, which would provide a multitude of services such as storing data, remote access, and over-the-air updates. The ESP32, once the EV is connected, can start charging the vehicle by sending commands to components used to regulate the flow of electricity to the battery. An ESP32 is also capable of monitoring battery voltage, temperature, and current during the charging process. The board will be able to stop the charging process if any abnormal value for the three parameters is detected.

articleTitle: Pose-Driven Dialogue Framework Integrating Agents and Locations for Elderly
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: In recent years, as the technology for human-machine interaction (HCI) has rapidly advanced, the challenge of low autonomy in human dialogue remains unimproved and presents a significant challenge. This is particularly presented by the elderly living at home, who may become increasingly isolated from society and less motivated to communicate. Building upon previous studies, we designed a human posture-driven conversational framework. The key idea was to integrate image-based location sensing with virtual agent (VA) technology. The proposed method makes use of Event-Condition-Action (ECA) rules and Pub/Sub routing techniques. Progress in this research facilitates personalized conversational support by inferring human states (i.e., context) and intentions.

articleTitle: Delphi Analytic Hierarchy Process and Geographic Information System Analysis on the Isochronic Circle of Life in Macao's Communities
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: With the rapid development of urbanization, the living convenience of community residents has increasingly become an important indicator to measure the livability of a city. This study is based on the DAHP method and GIS spatial analysis technology to conduct a convenience study on the living service facilities in Macao residential areas, And explore the coverage and accessibility of shopping, medical, entertainment, education, transportation and other life service facilities for Macao residents within the spatial scope of the 3-minute walking life circle and the 5-minute walking life circle, Evaluate the living convenience of Macao residential communities and provide data support for the Macao government to further improve community living service facilities.

articleTitle: Enhanced Network Media Application in Live-Streaming E-Commerce for Agricultural Products: A Systematic Approach Using Stimulus Organism Response Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Traditional marketing channels for agricultural products are limited, causing stagnant sales and limited direct access, which adversely affects their incomes. At the same time, the information asymmetry regarding agricultural products exposes consumers to a lack of knowledge about production, quality, and pertinent details, making them vulnerable to fraudulent practices. As the internet becomes widely available in rural areas, live-streaming e-commerce enables farmers to expand their products. Live-streaming e-commerce allows farmers to enhance consumer trust by directly disseminating information about the production process and quality. In order to develop a framework delineating the impact of immersive experience in Live-streaming e-commerce for agricultural products, we employed the Stimulus Organism Response (SOR) model. The external stimuli in question encompass perceived professionalism and interactivity, while the organism is characterized by immersive experience. This subsequently allows for a willingness of the consumer to purchase products. U sing structural equation modeling and questionnaires, we demonstrated the positive impact of perceived professionalism and perceived interactivity on the consumer's immersive experience. Sch immersive experience significantly impacted consumer willingness to purchase agricultural products. TO develop the SOR model, we integrated system flowcharts and analysis modules for live-streaming e-commerce and data analysis. The efficiency of the integrated system was verified in enhancing consumer engagement and sales turnover. The incorporation of live-streaming e-commerce in the agricultural industry facilitates the logistics of product sales and revitalizes rural communities. The implementation of a sales logistics data system in live-streaming e-commerce is important. Thus, based on the SOR model, farmers and merchants must collaborate in sales and logistics to increase the turnover rate of agricultural products.

articleTitle: Empowering Aging Populations: Implementing Robotics Solutions for Elderly
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: The anticipated doubling of the global elderly population by 2050 brings the increased risk and severe consequences of falls to the forefront, especially for those living on their own. This demographic trend underscores the critical need for forward-thinking solutions that enable seniors to live independently while ensuring their health and safety are not compromised. Addressing this challenge, we developed an allencompassing service for fall detection, which integrates meticulous monitoring and tracking capabilities. Utilizing the latest technology, including cameras and smartphones, an effective system is implemented for detecting falls. Moreover, this system can be enhanced by integrating a smart robot to provide customized assistance from alerting emergency services to contacting family members, depending on the individual's preferences and situation. Innovative technology is integrated with considerate and personalized care to empower seniors to maintain their independence and enjoy a high quality of life, ensuring their safety and well-being are prioritized.

articleTitle: Audio-Based Classification of Mild Cognitive Impairment Using XGBoost
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: To detect the mild cognitive impairment (MCI) of potential patients, we used the voice recordings of potential patients and applied the Extreme Gradient Boosting (Xgboost) algorithm for supervised MCI classification. The voice recordings were obtained from potential patients when they performed picture description tasks. In addition, we studied the feature selection based on feature ranking derived from Xgboost modeling. The frequency score of the latent speaker features was used for the feature selection problem. To examine the performance of the MCI classification using the Xgboost algorithm, the performance metrics of precision, recall, and accuracy were evaluated. For the K-fold cross-validation with K = 5, the achievable average accuracy, precision, and recall were 0.810, 0.821, and 0.937, respectively.

articleTitle: AI-Based Laryngoscope Equipped with Vocal Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: We present a novel automated laryngoscope system that leverages the computational capabilities of the NVIDIA Jetson Nano for automating throat scanning and accurately localizing vocal cords through imaging which enhances the success rates of endotracheal intubation. We introduced an artificial intelligence (AI) model effectively trained using a deep learning mechanism on the Jetson Nano platform. This model detects the vocal cords in real-time and guides the insertion of the laryngoscope and endotracheal tube. The development of conventional video laryngoscope was prompted by the significant failure rates associated with manual intubation. Through the automation of vocal cord localization and imaging, the system mitigates intubation risks, thereby enabling prompt and safer medical interventions. The in vitro experiment results conducted on Resusci Anne proved the potential application of technologies such as the Jetson Nano by enhancing the success rates of intubation procedures. By autonomously indicating the path to navigate the endotracheal tube toward the vocal cords, the system provides a progressive solution for the advancement of laryngoscopy techniques.

articleTitle: The Design of Multimodal-Based Micro-Expression Recognition Training Platform for Adolescents
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Adolescence is a phase of emotional and social skill development, during which emotional intelligence plays a crucial role in shaping adolescents' self-concept, enhancing social interactions, and improving academic performance. Previous research demonstrated that the accurate recognition of facial expressions is an integral component of emotional intelligence. Micro-expression recognition training can enhance expression recognition ability and emotional intelligence. We designed a multimodal-based micro-expression recognition training platform by combining visual, auditory, and interactive multimodal elements to promote the micro-expression recognition ability and emotional intelligence of adolescents. The platform offers adolescents an innovative training model that incorporates more engaging, interactive, and personalized training experiences.

articleTitle: Innovative Use of Augmented Reality Technology for Visual Interventions for Children with Autism
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Augmented reality (AR) technology has shown great potential and innovation in visual interventions for children with autism. AR technology provides a highly interactive and immersive learning environment for children with autism by superimposing virtual information onto the real world. This technology provides personalized and engaging instructional support for children with autism, such as social interactions, communication skills, and attentional and emotional abilities. The results showed improved vocabulary cognition, social interaction skills, and life skills in children with autism. AR technology also individualized curriculum based on individual assessment data that were collected through smart sensors and wearable devices. Such data support curriculum development and adjustment.

articleTitle: Alpha Anterior Posterior Index as a Novel Quantitative EEG Biomarker for Alzheimer's Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is the most prevalent form of dementia. Previous studies showed some promising biomarkers using quantitative electroencephalograms (qEEG), but more are waiting to be explored. This study aims to optimize and identify novel biomarkers to aid in diagnosing AD. This study uses a publicly available preprocessed EEG recording dataset from 19 electrodes to investigate power spectral density (PSD) patterns in AD and control (CN) groups. A novel PSD-derived biomarker, Alpha Anterior Posterior Index (aAPI), along with previously reported Alpha Relative PSD, Theta Alpha Ratio (TAR), and Spectrum Ratio (SR) biomarkers, are studied in diagnosing AD. Statistical analyses and machine learning using logistic regression models are employed to test the performance of these biomarkers. The results of our analysis reveal significant differences between AD and CN in the Alpha Relative PSD, Theta Relative PSD, TAR, SR, and the novel biomarker aAPI, with the Alpha band showing decreased power, Theta band showing increased power, TAR being higher, SR being lower, and aAPI being lower in AD compared to CN. Machine learning models, particularly the combination of aAPI and TAR, prove most effective in distinguishing between AD and CN, achieving the highest accuracy among all biomarkers. Individual biomarkers such as Alpha Relative PSD and Spectrum Ratio also exhibit relatively high accuracy, albeit not surpassing the combination of aAPI and TAR. The findings of this study suggest promising results for aAPI as a novel biomarker.

articleTitle: Road-Based Wireless Charging: Pioneering Self-Sustaining Electric Vehicle Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: The rapid growth in electric vehicle technology requires innovative solutions to address the current challenges and promote sustainability. In addressing these current challenges, we present a solution that is aimed to develop a self-sustaining electric car through road-based wireless charging technology. Modern electric vehicles frequently face challenges regarding range, battery life and infrastructure. The study presents a solution based on wireless charging technology integrated into road-based infrastructure. Our proposed system's key components comprise a high-power 24V wireless inductive coil module for efficient transmission of energy and a TP4056 lithium battery charging board with protection circuits to ensure safe charging of lithium batteries that are rechargeable. In addition, we use AA rechargeable NiMH batteries because of their dependable, long-lasting performance, and low self-discharge. Our study aims to build a self-sustaining electric car which will utilize energy from road infrastructure while driving, eliminating the need for frequent stops at charging points. This innovative approach not only improves the range and convenience of electric vehicles, but also helps to reduce the overall carbon footprint related to conventional means of transportation. We are seeking to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of our road-based wireless charging technology through theoretical simulation and practical tests.

articleTitle: Contributing Factors of Truck Crashes in Indonesia: Human Factor and Classification System (HFACS)
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Crashes on the road need to be addressed in developed and developing countries. Traffic crashes ranked eighth among all causes of fatalities, even surpassing HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, and diarrhoeal diseases globally. Truck crashes are the most severe road crashes as they result in injuries, damage to goods, and consequently economic losses. In 2021, material losses due to crashes reached USD 15.25 billion, with 12% dominated by freight transportation or trucks in Indonesia. Crash prevention in Indonesia focuses more on statistics and post-crash management, neglecting the contributing factors. Effective mitigation strategies, targeting these contributing factors, can significantly improve traffic safety. We identified the contributing factors of truck crashes in Indonesia using the Human Factors Analysis and Classification System (HFACS). The Contributory Factors Interaction Model (CFIM) was used to examine the relationship between factors by employing the odds-ratio statistical test for analysis. The relationship of crash characteristics was also investigated. 120 online news articles in Indonesia were collected as secondary data on crash investigations from January 2022 to May 2023. The results showed that 35% of unsafe behaviors were the most important contributor to crashes, followed by outside factors at 32%, preconditions for unsafe behaviors at 20%, and unsafe supervision and organizational influences at 7% each. Odds ratio analysis results revealed a relationship between latent and active failures. Latent failure factors influenced each other. As unsafe behaviors are a significant factor in truck crashes, they can be prevented. Even though secondary data was used, the results of this study serve as the basis for further research on truck crashes.

articleTitle: Daily Life Conversation in Bangla Sign Language Using Machine Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Sign language is a way of communicating and interacting for access to information. Currently, deaf and mute people rely heavily on sign language to communicate. It enables the challenged person to interact with a hearing-enabled person to express themselves and participate in all facets of life. In these circumstances, research is needed in the area of sign language recognition as limited work has been conducted. Also, as it varies from region to region and in the context of BangIa sign language, related research is more mandated. The dataset in this study consisted of 9,000 video data. Alongside this, Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) were used to establish a two-way communication system. LSTM is used for long-term dependencies and sequence predictions. To gather video data and extract characteristics from the video frames, MediaPipe and OpenCV were employed. Fine-tuning techniques, such as the number of hidden layers, the density of layers, the number of neurons within each layer, the learning rate, the optimizer, and other parameters were used to determine the optimal accuracy. The results showed that 96% of the categories were accurately represented by scikit-Iearn. This result offers a reference for employing deep learning structures for the detection of BangIa sign language and the development of dependable assistive technology tailored to the necessity of the hearing-impaired community.

articleTitle: EEG-Based Home Automation with SVM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: This paper outlines the creation of a model for possible research into using EEG data collected from a cap to control certain home appliances, i.e., TVs, computers, ovens, and more. The study aims to create a system where users can use measured beta signals to turn on appliances first. The idea is to create a low-level implementation, such as turning on or off devices, and then scale up to IoT devices to allow more control later. Creating a framework for identifying simple intentions can further develop systems that can interface with other home devices and improve the quality of life for those with neurodegenerative diseases that impair day-to-day activities.

articleTitle: Construction of Digital Competency Evaluation System Based on Analytic Hierarchy Process for Teachers of Local Vocational Colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: In the wave of education informatization, the digital competence of teachers has become the key to improving the quality of education. This study aims to construct a digital competency evaluation system for teachers in local vocational colleges and universities. Based on the (United Kingdom National Centre for the Evaluation and Accreditation of Qualifications) standard, the system analyzes the current situation and needs of local teachers. The system was developed through a literature review on digital technology, expert interviews, and empirical investigation. The Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) was adopted to assign weights and conduct consistency tests in four dimensions such as system-knowledge mastery, skill application, pedagogical innovation, and professional development. To process and analyze a large amount of empirical data, the Hadoop architecture was employed. The evaluation system assesses teachers' digital competence and the result can be used to guide teachers' professional development and training to meet the requirements of education informatization and improve the quality of teaching. The evaluation system in this study is flexible and scalable according to the conditions of different regions and types of vocational colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Anti-Fraud Modeling Algorithm of Credit Card Based on Value Function Coupling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Anti-fraud modeling is important for the bank credit card business. In this study, the value function is proposed as a new evaluation standard, and a loosely coupled anti-fraud modeling algorithm (PFLC) is developed. PFLC algorithm does not need to modify the underlying logic of the existing anti-fraud models and has strong portability. The theoretical upper bound and theoretical optimal solution of the proposed algorithm are derived in detail. Experiments were carried out based on the latest European credit card user data in 2023. The Fl score and value function score of the three modeling algorithms (cart, C4.5, and LR) were compared, and other mainstream traditional machine learning algorithms such as gbdt, xgboost, lightgbm, and other mainstream integrated learning algorithms. Compared with the traditional machine learning algorithm, the integrated learning+ Pflcalgorithm significantly improves the value function score of the model.

articleTitle: Visual and Thermal Imaging Camera-Based System for a Smart Cooking Assistant
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Homelessness is a condition that not only deprives individuals of a place to live but also exposes them to various risks, including malnutrition. Personalized cooking recipe recommendation systems have the potential to guide homeless individuals or those recently out of homelessness towards making informed dietary choices. However, a significant gap in current systems is their failure to cater to individuals with minimal cooking experience, offering little to no guidance on the actual cooking process. Addressing this critical gap, the present work introduces an innovative system designed to function as a smart cooking assistant. This system is not merely a passive repository of recipes but an active participant in the cooking process. It is built on the premise of observing users as they cook, utilizing a combination of hardware and advanced machine learning software to guide them through each step of the recipe meticulously. The system's hardware infrastructure is centered around the Raspberry Pi mini-computer, a compact yet powerful device capable of integrating various sensors, including a standard camera, an infrared thermal camera, and a humidity and temperature sensor. These components are strategically mounted above the cooking area, specifically focusing on the stovetop where the cooking vessel is placed. This setup enables the system to continuously monitor the cooking process. The core of the system's software is a deep learning image classification model that is generated using Google Vertex AI's Transfer learning functionality and trained on a dataset of 330 images collected from cooking pasta, captured through a smartphone camera and custom-designed hardware. By applying this method, the algorithm efficiently interprets the series of images to precisely identify the current stage of cooking and offer timely and automated suggestions. By offering a personalized, interactive, and educational cooking experience, the system not only aims to improve the nutritional intake of homeless individuals but also empowers them with the skills and confidence needed to cook healthy meals.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Market Demand Forecasting in Product Development
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Machine learning techniques are applied to forecast market demand and analyze their impact on the product development process. By collecting historical sales data and utilizing a variety of machine learning models for training and testing, the prediction accuracy of these models was validated with their advantages. Machine learning not only improves forecasting accuracy but also provides data-driven decision support for product development, which allows for optimizing resource allocation and market positioning.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Chronic Musculoskeletal Pain Using Vocal Prosodic Changes and Spatiotemporal Gait Factors
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Musculoskeletal pain is a major symptom of musculoskeletal diseases. Pain assessment lacks standardization, often relying on questionnaires and physician evaluations, with many unclear details. We studied techniques for diagnosing diseases by capturing changes in the involuntary elements of the voice caused by diseases. Physiological changes caused by pain affect the vocal cords. Furthermore, pain in the musculoskeletal system affects daily gait. Thus, we developed an objective evaluation index for chronic musculoskeletal pain using voice and spatiotemporal gait factors.

articleTitle: Face Anti-Spoofing Framework Based on Optical Flow Field Texture Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Deep learning is used to tackle a wide range of real-world problems. Face anti-spoofing is one of them which refers to the process of stopping fraudulent facial verification by substituting a mask, image, video, or other image to authorize individuals. Face anti-spoofing is important to prevent print and replay attacks that pose a significant danger to facial recognition systems. Numerous algorithms have been suggested to prevent such fraud. However, they showed poor accuracy. Therefore, we developed a detection method to detect facial movement and texture signals. The optical flows of a continuous video clip were extracted and analyzed for the movement's amplitude and direction. Next, the video frames were concatenated with the recovered optical flows as the network's input. To distribute the classification weights in an adaptable manner, region, and channel attention techniques were concurrently introduced. Finally, the combined motion and texture cues were sent into a convolutional network to extract features and determine whether the input video sequence represented a real face or not. Experimental results showed that the method showed high accuracy in detecting fraud.

articleTitle: Analysis of Communication Effect of City Tourism Brand Based on Social Network and Internet Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Using social network analysis (SNA), the key role of social networks in the communication of urban tourism brands was analyzed. By collecting and analyzing user interaction data from multiple social media platforms, a social network model of tourism brands was constructed to study the structural features of the network, the influence of key nodes (e.g., opinion leaders), and the path of information dissemination. The structural characteristics of the social network significantly affect the effectiveness of tourism brand communication. Especially, the central nodes in the network play a crucial role in the information dissemination process. Strategies to optimize content strategies were reviewed utilizing key nodes to enhance the communication efficiency and user engagement of tourism brands. Through quantitative analysis and modeling, a scientific basis for understanding the role of social networks in tourism brand communication is provided with technical guidance for the development of tourism brand communication strategies. The findings emphasize that the scientific use of social network analysis in tourism brands and related communication effectively enhances communication effects, user interaction, market competitiveness, and their brand values.

articleTitle: Deep Learning in Image Recognition for Optimizing Soybean Breeding
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: The application of deep learning in soybean breeding was explored using the optimization of image recognition technology for soybean variety identification and trait evaluation. First, a deep learning-based soybean image recognition system was constructed using a convolutional neural network (CNN) for feature extraction and classification of soybean images. A large amount of soybean image data was collected to classify and identify different varieties of soybeans, realizing efficient and accurate varietal identification. Deep learning technology was also applied to the evaluation of soybean traits, such as seed size and leaf morphology. Through the automated recognition and evaluation of soybean traits, the efficiency and accuracy of the breeding process were improved, which is an important technical method for soybean breeding.

articleTitle: Using Knowledge Graph and Deep Reinforcement Learning for Malware Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: With the development of e-commerce, e-commerce security incidents have caused information security to attract the attention of the general public. According to statistics, a large number of computers are infected by malware such as Trojans and zombies, and are used by the botnet. Malware can invade computer systems and exploit system or network vulnerabilities for intrusion. For malware detection, machine learning algorithms are used to detect malware, but they cannot incorporate background knowledge. Malware detection needs to be integrated with knowledge graphs, deep learning, and reinforcement learning. In this study, the proposed model was developed by employing deep learning, graph neural network, knowledge graph, and reinforcement learning to detect malware. To evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed model, the proposed model was evaluated with malware samples collected from MalwareBazaar, DikeDataset, and VirusShare and examined with accuracy, precision, and recall. Experimental results showed that the proposed model detected malware effectively.

articleTitle: Motor Imagery Classification System for Small Robotic Vehicle Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: A method to assist the elderly in their daily lives was developed using brainwave signals to control small robotic vehicles. With the continuous increase in the elderly population in Thailand, it is imperative to enhance their quality of life, especially for those living alone. The system proposed was tested with electroencephalography (EEG) signals from the Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCI) Competition II (dataset III) and BCI Competition III (dataset HIa), which consist of different Motor Imagery tasks (MI) involving imagining foot, tongue, right-hand, and left-hand movements. These signals are processed using a Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Hidden Markov Model (HMM), and then commands are sent to control a small robotic vehicle via an Arduino R3 microcontroller to move left, right, forward, and backward. This helps the elderly to manage household objects. The control efficiency of the small robotic vehicle was validated with an accuracy of 92.14%. Thus, this technology proved to assist in mobility and and be applied to healthcare, communication, and mental well-being, improving the quality of life for the elderly in society.

articleTitle: Cogging Reduction Method for Axial Flux Permanent Magnet Motor Utilizing Skew-Shaped Slot Rotor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: We introduced a novel rotor design featuring skew-shaped slots to minimize cogging torque in Axial Flux Permanent Magnet Motor (AFPM) motors. AFPM motors have a wider and larger magnet surface area than radial flux permanent magnet (RFPM) motors, resulting in a high torque density. These advantages make them a promising alternative for electric vehicles and industrial applications. However, AFPM motors increase cogging torque due to the use of a large-diameter rotor. The primary factor responsible for motor noise and vibration is cogging torque. To solve this problem, we analyzed the cogging torque of an AFPM motor with a skew-shaped slot rotor with 3D finite element analysis (FEA) using the JMAG-Designer software. We examined the cogging torque at various angles of the suggested skewed shape, comparing the cogging torque of the rotor featuring skewed-shape slots with that of the conventional rotor. The FEA analysis of the proposed skew-shaped slot rotor applied to the AFPM motor confirmed that the cogging torque decreased compared to the conventional rotor. Increasing the skew angle resulted in a reduction of cogging torque. The AFPM motor without skewed slots had a high cogging torque due to a significant variation in airgap magnetic flux density. In the proposed AFPM motor, skew-shaped slots were added to the rotor. The AFPM motor with the proposed skew-shaped slots reduced the amplitude of magnetic flux density fluctuation from peak to peak, resulting in a lower cogging torque. Consequently, the proposed method balanced the variation in magnetic reluctance and reduced cogging torque. These results confirm that the application of a rotor with a skew-shaped slot effectively reduces cogging torque in AFPM motors. A further experiment is required through actual motor fabrication and load analysis to validate the proposed approach.

articleTitle: GPT-Assisted Enhancement of Differential Diagnostics in Emergency Medicine
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Emergency Department (ED) settings demand rapid and accurate diagnostic assessments to ensure optimal patient outcomes and efficient healthcare delivery. Traditional differential diagnosis relies heavily on clinical acumen, which is susceptible to variability and error. Advances in artificial intelligence, particularly in natural language processing, offer a novel approach to support clinical decision-making processes. This study introduces a methodology utilizing a Generative Pretrained Transformer (GPT) model to analyze electronic health record (EHR) notes within the first 24 hours of ED admission. The model processes unstructured text to generate a ranked list of differential diagnoses. We evaluated the model's first prediction against actual discharge diagnoses to determine its accuracy and potential utility as a diagnostic aid. The GPT model's top prediction matched the discharge diagnosis in body system level with over 76% accuracy, indicating a robust capacity for accurate early diagnosis prediction. Incorporating GPT into the ED may substantially augment diagnostic accuracy, reduce time to diagnosis, and potentially lower healthcare costs through the optimization of resource allocation. By providing an immediate, ranked list of potential diagnoses, the GPT model assists clinicians in quickly formulating a targeted diagnostic strategy. This AIdriven approach could lead to improvements in patient outcomes by accelerating appropriate medical interventions.

articleTitle: Seasonal Dynamics and Spatial Non-Stationarity in the Relationship Between Urban Morphology and Land Surface Temperature
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: We explored the relationship between urban morphology and Land Surface Temperature (LST), focusing on the spatial non-stationarity of the relationship across different seasons. While urban form is known to influence LST, research on its seasonal spatial variations remains limited, despite its importance for sustainable urban development. Using the Multi-scale Geographically Weighted Regression (MGWR) model, significant seasonal and spatial differences were uncovered, and how urban form impacts LST was explored. Traditional approaches rely on annual averages and ignore spatial non-stationarity, failing to capture the effects of urban form on LST. The results showed pronounced seasonal influences, with certain urban form indicators such as Floor Area Ratio (FAR), and Building Height impact strengthened in specific seasons. The result highlighted the need for urban planning and the spatial and seasonal dynamics of urban form to effectively mitigate LST for sustainable urban environments.

articleTitle: Predicting Side Effects of Chemotherapy: Leveraging Machine Learning for Cancer Symptom Management
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: This study investigates the potential of machine learning (ML) to predict symptom escalation in chemotherapy patients using daily self-reported data. We analyzed self-reported health information from 339 patients, tracking 12 symptoms quantified by severity and distress to compile a comprehensive symptom score ranging from 0 to 230. To address the inherent challenge of dataset imbalance, we employed a stratified sampling technique. This involved dividing the dataset into several subgroups based on the severity of symptoms, and then randomly selecting an equal number of instances from each subgroup. This created a balanced dataset, thereby enhancing the reliability and robustness of our predictive models. We rigorously tested nine diverse ML models, including decision trees, discriminant analysis, and support vector machines (SVM), to predict changes in the total symptom score based on data from the preceding 3 to 5 days. These models were trained on the balanced dataset to mitigate the effects of the original data imbalance, and performance was also compared on the unbalanced dataset to evaluate the impact of data preparation on model efficacy. Our analysis highlighted the SVM classifiers' high accuracy rate of 82% on the unbalanced dataset, though they often misclassified severe symptom changes as less severe. In contrast, the Ensemble algorithm augmented with the RUSBoost classifier demonstrated exceptional precision across both datasets. It achieved accuracy rates of 61.16%, 58.41%, and 60.05% for datasets spanning 3, 4, and 5 days, respectively. This model effectively identified significant symptom changes, emphasizing the critical role of balanced datasets in ML training within health care contexts, where precision significantly affects patient care and outcomes. This research demonstrates the powerful capabilities of ML in cancer care, advocating for advanced algorithmic approaches and the optimized use of balanced datasets to enhance the effectiveness and impact of patient care strategies in cancer symptom management.

articleTitle: Survival Prediction in Breast Cancer Patients Based on Stacking Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 6th Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Breast cancer is one of the most common cancers among women, and accurately predicting its survival rate is crucial for personalized treatment and improved prognosis. We developed a breast cancer survival rate prediction model based on the Stacking method to improve prediction accuracy. We integrated traditional machine learning models such as logistic regression, support vector machines, random forests, and gradient-boosting decision trees.
